newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Retailing in Stop&Shop contract.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Retailing in Stop&Shop contract.

text.p: Electronic Retailing Systems International Inc said Wednesday it had a commitment to install additional ERS equipment in 21 of The Stop & Shop Supermarket Company Stores together with an order for a store utilizing the new generation wireless ShelfNet system. The order and commitment are subject to negotiation and settlement of a definitive contract including price, delivery and other material items.

The Stop & Shop Supermarket Company, Inc., a subsidiary of Ahold USA Holdings Inc, operates 185 supermarkets throughout Connecticut, Massachusetts, Rhode Island and New York. Stop & Shop has their headquarters in Quincy, Massachusetts.
